messages.subject: unexpected content in tabPanel
parts:
Here I scavenge csv files recursively, and then present them one directory at a time.  Unfortunately, only the least-nested file is ever displayed (but the tab labels are correct).  Can someone explain this behavior?

library(shiny)
dir.create('files')
write.csv(head(Theoph),'files/head.csv',row.names=FALSE)
write.csv(tail(Theoph),'tail.csv',row.names=FALSE)
files <- dir(full.names=TRUE, recursive=TRUE, pattern='\\.csv$')
ui <- pageWithSidebar(
  headerPanel=headerPanel('data'), 
  sidebarPanel=sidebarPanel(
    radioButtons('dirname','directory',unique(dirname(files)))
  ),
  mainPanel(
    uiOutput("tabsets") # https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/shiny-discuss/-xSng1348MU
  )
)
server <- function(input,output,session){
   output$tabsets <- renderUI({
     f <- reactive({files[dirname(files) == input$dirname]})
     tabs <- lapply(f(), function(nm)tabPanel(title=basename(nm),dataTableOutput(nm)))
     do.call(tabsetPanel, c(tabs))
   })
   for(f in files)output[[f]] <- renderDataTable(read.either(f))
}
runApp(list(ui=ui,server=server))
